request_context: Fallback to permitted public GDELT 15-minute batch feeds after DOC API HTTP429
interpretation: The GDELT DOC search API is rate-limited on both GitHub Actions and the authorized non-GitHub client. A public official GKG batch ZIP is downloadable and structurally readable without a key. This is evidence for a permitted batch-based future ingestion path, not proof that arbitrary news search or fact verification works.
limits: Only a 15-minute GKG batch ZIP and one sample row inspected
No full source provenance/rights verification or multi-hour index
No deployed JANUS server was accessed
No unreviewed GDELT content fed into model training
recommended_followup: Build a bounded, cached, attributable GKG batch metadata index; never evade DOC API rate limits. Keep metadata separate from trusted physics-training labels and independent clock holdouts.
